confidence_notes: Restaurant meal anchors rest on aggregated Numbeo-based and Expat Arrivals figures, with dates ranging from January 2026 to mid-2026. Coffee is the weakest food anchor: it draws on a Clever/GOBankingRates national average (year not stated), Numbeo via a secondary site, and a Denver-area Expatistan point. Beer and cocktail are mixed: beer reflects an Expatistan pub estimate and Denver full-price bar ranges, and cocktail is anchored to an Expatistan downtown-club figure and happy-hour ranges. Wine uses a Denver bar menu range. All four drink anchors are crowdsourced or secondary and have uncertainty of roughly 20 to 30 percent. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private, 1-star, 3-star) are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Denver summer lodging and the supplied context. They were not checked against live listings or booking pages, and no accommodation search was run. The FX observation was taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA overview page and RSS feed; I did not open the RBA page directly, and it is dated 2026-11-18, not the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Denver is treated as a mid-sized US metropolitan market with a high restaurant-price index relative to the national average. Food and drink anchors use US metro benchmarks cross-checked against Denver-specific figures where available. Accommodation uses a US metro summer-season basis in line with Denver's tourism demand.
